title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Accounts Reference: Business Return Confirmation and the Business Restocking Charge
content:
## Scope of the rule

On a Northgate Purchases & Returns purchase whose presenting membership is a Northgate Business Membership or a Northgate Business Plus Membership, the restocking on a changed-mind return of special-order merchandise is invoiced as a business restocking charge when the member confirms the return authorization through the member's own confirmation, entered as one restocking fee entry against the sale line on that authorization. It is not charged again when the refund is later posted, and a purchase presented on any other membership is outside this rule.

The business restocking charge on a changed-mind return is fixed only after the route pickup fee for that same return authorization stands on the purchase.

Restated: until a route pickup fee for the same return authorization stands on the purchase, the business restocking charge on that changed-mind return is not fixed.

## The member's confirmation tool: `confirm_business_return_92c81b09`

**Capability.** With this tool the business member confirms their own submitted return authorization for a freight pickup and accepts the restocking charge on it: the authorization changes from submitted to confirmed, one restocking fee entry for the amount given is booked today against the sale line being returned, and the purchase's net paid amount rises by that amount. Afterwards the authorization shows confirmed and the purchase's line history shows the restocking fee.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the member. The agent unlocks `confirm_business_return_92c81b09` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, with the values the representative hands over.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the member's submitted return authorization, read from the return authorization lookup | identifier |
| `order_id` | the purchase reference number the authorization belongs to, read from the purchase or return authorization lookup | identifier |
| `source_order_line_id` | the reference number of the sale line the authorization covers, read from the return authorization (its sale line) | identifier |
| `restocking_fee` | the restocking charge the member accepts, in USD, as quoted by the representative | a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places at booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `return_authorization_id` (the authorization confirmed), `authorization_status` (always confirmed), `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the new restocking fee entry), `amount` (the restocking charge booked, USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_paid_amount` (the purchase's net paid amount afterwards, USD, 2 decimal places). An `authorization_status` of confirmed indicates success.
